title: Sweep Lens
caption: Scanning arcs follow KOL activity as it changes.
meaning: Two scanning arcs represent continuously observing KOL wallet activity.

title: Refracted View
caption: A signal passes through two optical surfaces.
meaning: Two lens surfaces bring the signals in wallet trades into focus.

title: Triad Lens
caption: Wallets, trades and tokens share one focal point.
meaning: Three optical segments represent wallets, trades and tokens meeting in one view.

title: Focus Window
caption: A focused window onto the traders you follow.
meaning: A focus frame and lens curves represent looking closely at tracked KOLs.
